notes.title: Happy Holidays From KEL! Come Check-Out Our New Game!
notes.content:
Greetings!

Halloween's coming, and Kel couldn't be more prepared. He's been walking around in his costume already for ages! With the new season approaching though, we felt like the time was right to fill the general public in on an even bigger game project of ours that most people don't realize we've been trying to get going since before Kel walked among the living; A game we call Divergence: Online

Divergence is a game that began development well before Kel, but it wasn't until Kel was completed and launched on Steam were we able to really give it the improvements it needed. Now many of those new features are in place, and we can't wait to tell you about them. :)

Divergence was designed as the spiritual successor to Star Wars: Galaxies, but it ended up becoming an animal, we believe, totally unique and even more powerful than its parent.

It's a game about humans, aliens, and synthetic beings stranded on an alien moon far from Earth, and the struggle for survival of three factions, of which you get to choose your loyalty, trying to figure out what happened while building some sort of survivable surroundings for themselves at the same time.

It's a much, much bigger game than Kel and because of this requires more resources, so we're really hoping people will give it a look and choose to help us make it a reality.

To help drive interest, we're even including a free copy of KEL Reaper of Entropy to anyone who contributes at or above the $10 level to help us make Divergence a reality. Plus, you can even download the current alpha version of our new game FREE off the campaign page below to try it and see if you like where we're going with it before contributing. Just follow the link below!

http://igg.me/at/divergenceonline/x/2437573

Thanks for taking the time to read and happy holidays to all!

notes.title: December Update & Charity Event Ongoing!
notes.content:
Winter is here and Christmas is approaching fast, so we're happy to announce that we'll be donating half of the Steam sales for December to [url=http://www.gamesaid.org/]GamesAid[/url], who help disadvantaged and disabled children and young people.

Moreover, players who update to the latest version of KEL will notice that it's been snowing in the game and the village is preparing for the Winter Holidays ;)

So we hope you'll enjoy the 'frosty' new feel of Kel the Skeleton and help us raise funds for the GamesAid charity!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=359319650]http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=359319650[/url]

notes.title: November Update and Upcoming Charity Event
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that thanks to some amazingly helpful players, we've made more progress with our game for the November update.

There are changes to the mechanism for converting villagers, as well as a different reaction from them if you kill the Hermit on your own. There's also a series of minor bug fixes, however many of the changes will probably not take effect if you use a saved game instead of starting a new one.

In addition, we're preparing to participate with KEL in a Christmas charity event. All the sales from the game will go to charity. We'll post more updates as soon as the details are decided upon.

So we're expecting a slight chill in the game as winter settles in and KEL gets ready to take Santa's place ;)

notes.title: KEL celebrates his first birthday today with free keys!
notes.content:
It's been exactly one year since we've started working on KEL Reaper of Entropy. It's been both fun, crazy, and difficult, and we're grateful for all the amazing players who have been by our side during this journey. With your help and feedback, we've been able to experiment and create something different, strange, amusing, out-of-the-ordinary.

Now we're almost ready to leave Early Access and do an official Steam release next week.

To celebrate, we're hosting a little trivia key giveaway based on some of our favorite games of all time. Enjoy! ;)

?PHG6-6JKLV-0GJL2
? = the first letter in the name of the final boss at the end of Act I in Diablo II

?5BIL-QWT06-WA5LD
? = the first letter in the name of the area where the action takes place in Gothic II

P26?I-J2F92-7MWTQ
? = the first letter in the name of the princess turned Striga in The Witcher

?EILF-YGWKR-V533G
? = the first letter in the name of the developers who brought us Vampire the Masquerade Bloodlines

?XP9R-6VJLI-5JW4K
? = the first letter in the name of the princess who is a protagonist in Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time and Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones

notes.title: Major Bug Fixes, Other News, and Free Keys
notes.content:
We'd like to thank everyone for their feedback and bug reports.

For those of you who have experienced Steam achievements not unlocking, please update the game, then simply start a new game to have those achievements unlock retroactively.

If you're having trouble launching the game, please check this thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/317950/discussions/0/35222218645822958/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/317950/discussions/0/35222218645822958/[/url]

We've also fixed dialogue texts being cut off and increased the character walking speed.

Last but not least, we'd like to thank everyone who has wished well to John, the team-mate with the crash. He's feeling better now and today happens to be his birthday. He has asked me to hand out KEL keys as a sort of birthday treat, so the first three comments to this post get a free key!
